data.exact_reserve_text: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 19.2m (2015: GBP 28.9m), on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2015.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior-year release of GBP 19.2m for 2016 (a c.17% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 113.48m). The movement is described as a favourable movement on prior year gross claims reserves; no detailed LOB split or quantified event-level drivers are given in the disclosed sentence.
raw_causal_phrases: There were favourable movements during the year of GBP 19.2m (2015: GBP 28.9m) on prior year gross claims reserves, held at 31 December 2015.
data.data_quality_notes: Figures extracted from scanned pages. Opening gross claims outstanding (prior year, 2015) taken from the Statement of Financial Position (balance sheet) comparative column; readable value interpreted as GBP 113,480k = 113.48m. Prior-year movement (favourable) is taken verbatim from the Technical Provisions / notes sentence stating GBP 19.2m release on prior year gross claims reserves (page 29). Gross premium (49,928) taken from Managing Agent's Report key metrics (page 5). Segmental breakdown (gross_premium_mix) and a reliable gross claims development triangle could not be robustly read from scanned images, so these fields are left empty. Where page legibility was marginal, conservative confidence scores have been applied.
